categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in real estate development and construction, polyurethane (PU) resin and synthetic leather manufacturing, and health food retail. Real estate activities include land investment, building design, construction, and sales. The chemical segment focuses on PU resin, adhesives, and synthetic leather products. Health food sales represent a smaller portion of the business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer chemistry and formulation technologies for PU resin and synthetic leather production, including nano-grinding technology to enhance product properties. It emphasizes environmentally friendly materials with solvent reduction and water-based formulations. In real estate, the company applies rigorous project planning, quality control, and green building design incorporating energy-saving and sustainable construction methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include end consumers and investors in the residential real estate market, particularly in Taiwan's Tainan region. The chemical products serve downstream industries such as footwear, apparel, automotive, furniture, and electronics manufacturers. The health food segment targets retail consumers. The company also collaborates with major technology firms for advanced material applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with a strong focus on Tainan City for real estate development. The chemical products are sold mainly domestically with some exports to Asia and other regions. The company has strategic partnerships with domestic and international firms but no significant overseas manufacturing presence currently.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in its segments. In real estate, it functions as a developer and builder, coordinating land acquisition, construction, and sales. In chemicals, it manufactures PU resins and synthetic leather materials, supplying downstream manufacturers. It maintains control over raw material sourcing and product formulation, positioning itself as a midstream producer with some vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing environmentally friendly and high-performance PU resin products, expanding applications in flexible OLED displays, automotive, and furniture sectors. The company invests in R&D for solvent reduction, water-based materials, and advanced coatings. In real estate, focus is on high-quality, differentiated housing projects with green building certifications and innovative design to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of completed real estate properties, PU resin and synthetic leather products, and health food retail. Real estate revenue is recognized upon project completion and handover. Chemical product sales are based on volume shipments to industrial customers. The company also issues convertible bonds and equity financing to support operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In real estate, the company competes with other Taiwanese developers focusing on mid-to-high-end residential projects, leveraging brand reputation and quality differentiation. In the chemical sector, it faces competition from domestic and international resin manufacturers but maintains a niche through specialized PU resin formulations and customer collaborations. The company positions itself as a quality-focused, innovation-driven player in both sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.49 billion in 2023, showing a recovery from a prior year decline due to reduced real estate deliveries. It experienced net losses in recent years but improved operating results in 2023. Total assets increased by over 30% year-over-year, reflecting business expansion and acquisitions. The company invests around 1-2% of revenues in R&D and maintains a stable capital structure with ongoing convertible bond issuances.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, durable, and environmentally friendly building projects with unique architectural designs that cater to premium market segments. Its chemical products offer advanced performance, customization, and eco-friendly features that meet stringent customer requirements. The integration of art and culture into real estate developments and continuous innovation in resin technology differentiate the company from competitors.
